name: hud_ui_background_cursor_rebuild_captured_image
description: HudUiBackgroundCursorWidget::RebuildCapturedImage builds a source rectangle from the cursor origin and source image size, copies that surface rectangle into the captured image, and updates the widget blit source plus clip rect on success or clears it on failure.
known_limits: The smoke covers the successful capture path through the software surface state. Failure clearing is source-reviewed against Binary Ninja and uses the same SetBltSourceAndClipRect dispatch as the disable path.
tier S verification is deferred to a coherent HudUiBackground cursor-widget pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4bfba0 validates the null capturedImage guard, source rect from origin plus base image width/height, zVideo_buff::CopySurfaceRectToImage call with captureSourceSelector, success clip rect computed relative to origin, and ftable slot 6 SetBltSourceAndClipRect dispatch for success/failure.
The native smoke verifies a successful surface capture copies the expected pixels and installs the captured image and relative clip rect on the widget.
